Resolves #20046

One press on the tab overflow control of an unfocused Workstation pane now opens its menu. The press used to focus the pane, which revealed the focus-gated action rail beside the control and re-partitioned the strip under the pointer, so the release landed on a different button and no click fired anywhere; the second press opened the menu. The fix is a hold: the toolbar can keep a focus-gated reveal back for a named reason, and the overflow plugin holds it for exactly as long as a press can still click the control — taken by a primary press on the control, released when the pointer leaves it with the button down, taken again when it returns with the button still down — and, once the click opens the menu, hands it to the menu at its mount (the menu's hold is taken before the press's is released, so there is no gap); a click that closes the menu or opens none releases at once; the owed reveal lands when the menu closes. No timer decides when a press ends. A keyboard focus, a tab click, the hover-reveal option and the rail's order are unchanged. Also fixed on the way: the hidden measurement reveal restored a withheld action's style by deleting the key, which the vdom style merge never removes, and withdrew the node in the same update, so the vnode kept `visibility: hidden` for its next reveal; the restore now writes `null` and lands before the withdraw.

Evidence: L4 (headed Chrome through the Neural Link e2e tier with the Brain runtime on the author's seat; the walk's pointer harness as the independent witness; deterministic unit arms for the hold's lifetime) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2 are pointer-and-DOM observables). Residual: a press abandoned over the control (the button released off-page) keeps the hold until the pointer leaves the control; a hide and re-show of the menu that coalesce without a `mounted` flip keep it until the next closing click or the control's teardown — both bounded, neither ends under an active press; the known load-sensitive reload arm is named under Test Evidence, Residual-Owner: #20022.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline unit (dashboard, tab, toolbar, plugin) and the full local `e2e/workstation` + `e2e/dashboard` battery ran on the first head; the owning unit trees and the six nearest e2e specs ran on the final head.

## Deltas from ticket
The ticket offered two shapes (open after the re-partition settles, or reserve the rail's width). A third shipped: hold the reveal while the control is pressed or its menu is open. Two other shapes were built, measured and withdrawn before this body: reserving the rail's span in the partition (in a 180 px single-tab strip it truncated the only tab to "Qu…", in a two-tab strip it hid a tab that fit) and placing the contribution after the focus-gated actions (it contradicted the toolbar's documented contract and `WorkstationMaximizeTabReorderNL`'s frozen rail order, and the hold made it unnecessary). Neither is in this diff. Round 2 (review RA-1): the hold's lifetime was first bounded by a 1500 ms safety timer and a 250 ms post-click delay; both are gone — the lifetime is the press and the menu, as described above. The hold's unit arms live in the plugin's own spec (`unit/tab/plugin/Overflow.spec.mjs`, which owns the mountable menu-list fixture), so the PR touches five files.
